name: Micro-environment Grand Challenge for Adaptive Autonomous Agents
description: A micro-environment benchmark designed to evaluate adaptive autonomous intelligent agents on tasks that test learning and adaptation capabilities.
reputation: Niche research benchmark from the adaptive agents community with limited but sustained use in academic studies on online adaptation.
notes: Simulator-based, non-LLM benchmark; small/narrow task suite risks overfitting; different works report either success rate or reward making cross-paper comparison variable.
